note: Paired Metal GPU measurements with three 120-frame repetitions per gesture and world. Head includes culling and the fast scalebar; the manual motion helper stayed inactive. Callback time improved, but the 100K wheel frame p95 remained about 133 ms and 100K near pan worsened. Traces show forced layout shifted into input dispatch. No physical FPS claim. A separate one-repetition 30-frame correctness run passed complete scalebar outerHTML parity against the precise normal renderer for both worlds; it does not replace the primary timing pair.
